title: weloan
tagline: cloning aave, but trying to make its  UI easy to use and simple.
description: i'm trying to clone aave, cuz alot of people face issue using aave cuz they think it's little complex so i'm trying to clone aave to provide a better UX to the user, currently it is on mumbai testnet but soon will be shifted on mainnet. people can be able to take loan and stake token on it easily.
how_its_made: I have used next.js framework to build it and currently using mumbai chain to run it, all the stake and loan thing are done on mumbai chain. i'm trying to add GHO token in it so people can also borrow and stake GHO on it, for now their are only few token on my weloan app more will be added soon.
